title: Drop Overhaul
description: Pick up a loose object, hold it still in front of you, turn and move it precisely, then set it down.

Keys.label: Pick up / place
Keys.hint: Picks up what you're looking at (whatever the activation prompt is for); press again to place it.

Keys.label: Put back
Keys.hint: Returns the held object to where it was.

Keys.label: Upright
Keys.hint: Upright, facing the same way as you.

Keys.label: Fine adjustment (hold)
Keys.hint: While held, turning and moving are slower.

Keys.label: Drops / stays in place
Keys.hint: Switches the held object between dropping when placed and staying exactly where placed.

Placement.label: Drop when placed
Placement.hint: On: physics takes over when you place an object, and it settles onto what's below it. Off: it stays exactly where you placed it, even in mid-air, until the area reloads.

Placement.label: Turn with you
Placement.hint: The held object turns as you turn, keeping the same side towards you.

Placement.label: Move objects without physics
Placement.hint: Also move some furniture and clutter that has no physics. Their collision may not follow the object.

Placement.label: Fine adjustment speed
Placement.hint: Fraction of the normal speed while the fine adjustment key is held.

General.label: HUD messages
General.hint: Holding, Put back, Can't move that, and so on.
